Subject: Performance Bank Guarantee for Performance Bond — Tender Ref: RFP-132006596
Dear Sir/Madam,
WHEREAS National Infrastructure Corp. Ltd. (hereinafter called the "Contractor/Principal") has
submitted a bid vide Tender Reference RFP-132006596 dated 2020-09-24 for the work of Irrigation
Works, and
WHEREAS as a condition precedent for the award of the contract, the Contractor is required to furnish a
Performance Bank Guarantee for 5% (five percent) of the contract value, and
WHEREAS the Contractor has requested Union Trust Bank of India (hereinafter called the "Guarantor") to
issue this Performance Bank Guarantee in your favour.
NOW THEREFORE, we, Union Trust Bank of India, do hereby irrevocably and unconditionally guarantee
to pay to you, on first written demand without protest or demur, an amount not exceeding INR 1.11 Cr
(Rupees 1.11 Crore Only), being Performance Bond amount, subject to the following terms:
Terms and Conditions
Liability: Our total liability under this Bank Guarantee shall not exceed INR 1.11 Cr (India Rupees
Rupees 1.11 Crore Only).
Validity: This Guarantee shall remain valid from 2020-09-24 until 2024-06-06 (the "Expiry Date")
unless extended by mutual consent in writing.
Claim Period: We shall be liable to pay under this guarantee only if a written claim or demand is
served upon us on or before the Expiry Date.
Enforceability: Any claim arising under this guarantee shall be enforceable at our branch office
at Mumbai or at any scheduled bank branch in India as nominated by the claimant.
No Defence: Our obligation to pay is absolute and unconditional. We shall have no right of set-
off, counterclaim, or defence arising from any dispute between the Contractor and the Employer.
Modification: This guarantee shall not be affected by any change in the constitution, ownership,
or control of the Contractor or the Employer.
